title: Covering design records: explicit covering designs improving the best known sizes
description: Explicit covering designs improving the best known size listed by the Covering Repository. This version: a (89,8,3) covering design with 2606 blocks (previous best 2611, Bluskov and Sidorenko), covering all 113564 triples, obtained by post-optimisation of their design. Includes the program and a verification script.
